name: exponential polynomial closure method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以指数多项式形式近似概率密度并闭合求解的方法。
usage_overview: 用于非线性随机振子瞬态或非平稳响应的概率密度近似求解，以多项式的指数表示密度，并通过有限组投影条件确定系数，将密度求解转化为有限个系数的确定问题。

complete_examples.text: Numerical analysis show that the extended exponential polynomial closure method with polynomial order being six is both effective and efficient for solving the transient analysis of the stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by comparing the numerical results obtained by the proposed method with those obtained by Monte Carlo simulation method.

P045.title: Transient probabilistic solutions of stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by exponential polynomial closure method
